title: Reference table: AFD 1.0 entity code -> AFD 2.0 entity / entityType
description: AFD Short -> AFD 2.0 is rename-only: one rule per AFD 1.0 entity code rewrites every XX_LABEL to its AFD 2.0 attribute name, XX_ENTITEI to the entityType name, XX_ENTREF to refKey. Values, arrays and types are untouched. Entities nested inside another entity are lifted into the root entity arrays with the explicit reference the nesting implied.
